components.name: focus-visible CSS layer
auditScope: focus-visible ring on all interactive surfaces
components.notes: Low-priority @layer ensures component-level overrides win without !important. Uses --ring design token for dark-mode and theming consistency. WCAG 2.1 AA SC 1.4.11 satisfied via 3 px outline with 2 px offset.

components.name: SkipToContent
auditScope: correct anchor target on all layouts
components.notes: WCAG 2.1 AA SC 2.4.1 (Bypass Blocks). Rendered as the first child of <body> in the root layout, so it precedes navigation on every page. Uses sr-only / focus:not-sr-only pattern with fixed positioning when focused. Target anchor id="main-content" is present on the <main> element in both the dashboard and marketing layouts.

components.name: MobileBottomTabs badge
components.notes: WCAG 2.1 AA SC 1.4.11 and 4.1.3 satisfied. Tab labels announce unread notifications politely without visually cluttering layout.
